about: Vois shape roles (vois-tokens DS-SHAPE-001). Each role is a behavior, not only a number: fixed (a radius token), proportional (round corners that grow with the surface, clamped), elliptical (a percentage per axis), capsule (fully round ends) or circle. build-tokens.mjs writes vois/tokens/shape-tokens.css from this file. These values live in code, not Figma: Figma radius variables can only hold numbers. Fixed roles point at the Figma radius roles, so they follow Figma.

--shape-sharp.note: No rounding: full-bleed media, table cells, edge-to-edge bars.

--shape-subtle.note: Buttons, inputs, selects and other controls (Figma: 6).

--shape-pill.note: Tags, chips, pill tabs, segmented controls, status indicators: the height sets the curve.

--shape-circle.note: Avatars, radio dots, round icon buttons.

--shape-responsive-soft.note: Large image-led surfaces, hero media, editorial and promo tiles: round corners that grow with the container's width, from 16 to 40.

--shape-responsive-elliptical.note: A distinctive media surface where elliptical corners are intended. Round on a 3:2 box, elliptical on any other shape.
